column2: (Well, well... So this is roughly the battle data against a $$神官$$...)
(The power of that $$大邪神$$ armor... it truly is entirely unlike our own God's...)
(No wonder even the $$教皇$$ fears it...)
(I must report to $$総本山$$ at once...
and hurry the formation of a new extermination squad...!)
(But that armored man...
something about looking at his face makes me shiver with excitement...)
(I want to keep him all to myself... and bully him!)
(Besides, I feel as though we have met somewhere before...?)
(Hah!!)
That woman in purple... She is writing in her cursed revenge $$日記$$ over there...!
Who would keep a thing like that?!
